responsibility: Declares the pass-0 symbol and block-structure builder used during the first syntactic scan of a Modula-2 source file. It provides entry points to register outer and inner modules, procedures, imports, and module endings, plus initialization and block-enter/leave traversal support, so later passes can replay the discovered nesting tree and import universe without yet performing full type construction.
same_name_distinction: This is the API surface for pass-0 symbol-building support, declaring the block/module/procedure registration and traversal entry points that the generated P0 parser calls; P0SymBuild.mod contains the block-tree construction and replay logic.
